name: a feature-name wordmark cycles through a rail of choices
looks: A single feature name fills the frame in a bold holographic, gradient-stroked face, hard-cutting to the next name on the beat. Beneath it, a small breadcrumb row lists every name in the set, the current one bold and underlined, the rest dim, so the cycling reads as one position in a known list rather than a random sequence.
build: Each name is its own DOM block, hard swapped with no crossfade, kit.beat(n, bpm); the gradient-stroke fill uses a moving background-position on a text-clip mask so the colour shimmers as each name holds. The breadcrumb rail is a fixed row of labels; the live one's weight and underline update exactly on the same cut as the big name, reusing the dash-rail idea as words instead of dashes.
sound: A hit on each name's hard cut, a light shimmer under the holographic fill, a brighter chime on the last name.
prompt: Cycle a single feature name across the full frame in a bold, shimmering treatment, hard-cutting name to name on the beat. Track progress with a small row of every name underneath, the current one bold, so the rhythm reads as moving through a known set of features rather than a random flash.
